subject: Aurora Health — VPC pricing mix and platform-fee amortization proposal
messages:
From: Elaine Rodriguez <elaine.rodriguez@aurorahealth.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com, amit.verma@aurorahealth.com
Date: 2026-08-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aurora — VPC pricing breakdown request

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to get a more granular view of the commercial options for a private VPC/on-prem deployment — specifically:

- How the platform fee can be amortized (upfront vs monthly) and the impact to ARR and invoicing.
- Support tier definitions and pricing (Standard / Priority / SRE retainer).
- Any implementation credits or concessions you can provide for a multi-year commit (we're evaluating 24-month and 36-month paths).

Can you send a short options matrix and a redlineable SOW we can share with Finance? We'd like to present an internal recommendation next Thursday.

Also please call out SLA credits and whether the platform fee can be split across two cost centers (infra + application).

Appreciate it,
Elaine
Elaine Rodriguez
VP, Infrastructure
Aurora Health Systems
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Rodriguez <elaine.rodriguez@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora — VPC pricing breakdown request

Hi Elaine,

Thanks — attached are a first pass: aurora_pricing_v1.xlsx (options matrix) and a draft SOW (sow_vpc_onprem_draft.pdf). High level summary below so your Finance/Procurement folks have quick points for the internal review.

1) Platform fee amortization
- Option A: Upfront platform fee (one-time) — lowest unit economics for Redwood, one invoice; recommended if Aurora capitalizes.
- Option B: Amortized monthly over contract term — spreads cost across OPEX, we can invoice monthly or quarterly.
- Impact: amortizing over 24 months reduces monthly cash outlay ~42% vs upfront for the baseline platform fee in the spreadsheet.

2) Support tiers (examples in sheet)
- Standard: business-hours support, 24h bug triage window.
- Priority: 24/7 incident response, 4h P1 response, plus access to priority queue for engineering.
- SRE retainer: dedicated engineering hours (blocks), optional on-call for cutover/rollouts.

3) Multi-year concessions
- 24-month commit: baseline offer = 10% list discount on metered/seat pricing + 6 months of standard SRE hours (remote) included.
- 36-month commit: 15% list discount + 3 months implementation credit (applied as invoice credit).

4) SLA credits and cost-center split
- SLA credits: we can include standard SLA credit language (financial credit up to X% for sustained outages) — we'll add the exact percentages to the SOW.
- Cost-center split: Yes, we can split the platform fee across two cost centers on the invoice; we need PO numbers for each billing owner.

Next steps: would you be available for a 30-minute budget alignment call tomorrow or Friday? If you prefer, we can produce a ‘final commercial’ in DocuSign for signature once we align on term and support bundle.

Attachments: aurora_pricing_v1.xlsx (pricing matrix), sow_vpc_onprem_draft.pdf

Best,
Monica Patel
Head of Enterprise Sales (Private)
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-12T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Aurora — VPC pricing breakdown request

Team — fwding the ask from Aurora. Key asks: amortization options, SLA credits, and potential credits for 24/36m commit. Quick thoughts:

- My initial offer locks 10% on 24m and 15% on 36m. Finance may push back; consider replacing % with a $ implementation credit for easier P&L treatment (Marissa suggestion below).
- Support: propose Priority + 6 months of SRE hours included on 24m. For 36m include 12 months and 1 FTE onboarding support as a discount kicker.
- We should anticipate a PO split request — confirm billing ops can handle split invoices.

Can Marissa run a P&L with: (A) 10% discount + no implementation credit vs (B) 5% discount + $180k implementation credit (applied across first 6 invoices). Also, flag any SRE capacity constraints with Grace.

Thanks — will keep Aurora in the loop after your feedback.
Monica
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-12T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aurora — VPC pricing breakdown request

+1 to swapping percentage for a fixed implementation credit. For mid-market health systems that capitalize some costs, a credit reads better to finance and avoids discount perception for renewals. My proposal:

- Commercial proposal: 24m commit, 12% off list across metered and seats + $180,000 implementation credit (applied as invoice credits over first 6 months).
- Platform fee: amortize monthly for Aurora with invoicing split by cost center — ops ok with that if POs provided.
- Support: Priority tier + SRE retainer (100 hours/month for first 3 months, then 20 hours/month ongoing for 12 months).

I attached a quick alternative pricing sheet (pricing_options_v2.xlsx) with line items and modeled revenue impact. Legal will need to confirm if we can bind SLA credit percentages at this level; Sean — can you check with Legal/RevOps re: SLA credit thresholds?

-Marissa
From: procurement@aurorahealth.com <procurement@aurorahealth.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: elaine.rodriguez@aurorahealth.com, amit.verma@aurorahealth.com
Date: 2026-08-14T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora — VPC pricing breakdown request

Monica,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the set of options. A few clarification requests from Procurement and Finance:

- We prefer an amortized platform fee and monthly invoices; please provide the exact amortized monthly amounts for the 24m and 36m paths showing total invoice cadence.
- The implementation credit as proposed by Marissa is acceptable in principle, but can we see the final commercial with the credit applied line-by-line?
- SLA credits: please include the specific credit percentages tied to incident severity and duration — Finance wants an explicit cap.
- For the cost-center split, we will provide two PO numbers; confirm Redwood’s invoice will include both PO references and a breakdown for each PO.

If you can provide a doc we can circulate internally (DocuSign-ready), we can target an executive approval on Wednesday the 19th.

Thanks,
Aurora Procurement
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Rodriguez <elaine.rodriguez@aurorahealth.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-16T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Final commercial: 24m commit — platform amortization + implementation credit

Elaine / Procurement,

Thanks — we've aligned internally and can move forward with the following final commercial for Aurora Health Systems. I've attached the final commercial PDF (AU_final_commercial_20260816.pdf) and prepared a DocuSign-ready envelope (link below).

Final offer (24-month committed path):
- Term: 24 months (auto-renew opt-in).
- Platform fee: amortized monthly across 24 months. Example monthly amortized platform fee: $45,800 (see attached line-item schedule).
- Usage/Seats: 12% discount off list for committed usage and seat licenses.
- Implementation credit: $180,000 applied as invoice credits over the first 6 months (30k/mo).
- Support: Priority tier + SRE retainer 100 hrs/mo for first 3 months, then 20 hrs/mo for months 4–12; ongoing Priority support thereafter.
- SLA credits: P1 sustained >5 minutes and <120 minutes = 10% credit for impacted invoice; sustained outage >120 minutes = 25% credit; annual cap for SLA credits = 10% of annualized fees. (Legal happy to add exact language in SOW.)
- Billing: We can issue split invoices referencing two PO numbers; please provide PO owners and numbers at signature.

Next steps:
1) Review attached final commercial.
2) If acceptable, sign the DocuSign envelope here: https://www.docusign.com/link/aurora-au-2026-014
3) Provide PO numbers for split invoicing and any internal cost-center tags.

If you prefer a 36-month stretch, we can update to 15% discount + $300k implementation credit — happy to model that on request.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.
Monica Patel
Head of Enterprise Sales (Private)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: AU_final_commercial_20260816.pdf
